text:
I am building Abbox trying to help engineers focus longer on tasks without being interrupted by non-technical people with small requests.

I always got annoyed by change this h1 to h2, add tracking to share button, why can’t the customer play the video, the styles don’t match figma.

If you are engineer who also gets distracted I would love to hear your opinion and feedback. It is a bit hard to put it all together as every department has his own needs and opinion about the website.

My email kamran.elchuzade@gmail.com
